_comment: Staleness/refresh policy for the native project-state artifact (specs pose-project-state-artifact, pose-project-state-refresh-contract). Optional: absent means pose-mcp uses these same defaults. max_age_days is checked against generated_at; max_commits is checked against baseline_commit via `git rev-list --count`, when a git repo is available. strict_refresh: false means a failed automatic refresh (post-event hook) never blocks the command that triggered it — it marks refresh_pending in the state frontmatter instead; true makes that failure block the triggering command.
